name: The Lantern Road
tagline: A message becomes a road home.
description: Lead Captain Nera through a haunted river valley. Escort a courier, reclaim villages, and silence the graves. Human infantry, wardens, and adepts face the undead.

ending.speaker: Nera
ending.text: We will leave a lantern at each crossing. Not as a warning. As a way home.

ending.speaker: Ivo
ending.text: I have a new list. This one has everyone who made it.
